This tune was written by a great compsoer by the name of Diarmaid Moynihan. Also comsposed “The Waterbed” (from Lunasa’s first) and “The Malbay Shuffle” (from The Merry Sisters of Fate). Also composed a lot of tune done by Grada.

Thanks for posting it cvn.
